units.source_text: 他在归途上想：“我只管如此愁恨，将来如何是好呢？

en.t: On his way back, he thought, "If I go on grieving and resenting things like this, what will become of me?

units.source_text: 有什么办法可使我不受世人讥评而又如意称心呢？”

en.t: Is there any way for me to have what I want without drawing the world's criticism?"

units.source_text: 想是由于对恋爱一道缺乏经验之故吧，

en.t: Perhaps it was because he had so little experience in the ways of love,

units.source_text: 他往往无端地替自己又替别人考虑未来可忧之事，

en.t: but he often worried without cause about future troubles, both for himself and for others,
and stayed awake all night until dawn.

units.source_text: 他想：“二女公子说那人酷肖大女公子，

en.t: He thought, "The second young lady says that person closely resembles the eldest young lady,

units.source_text: 但不知是否真实，总得看一看才好。

en.t: but I do not know whether that is true; I ought at least to see her for myself.

units.source_text: 她的母亲身份不高，则求爱想必不难。

en.t: Since her mother's rank is not high, courting her should not be difficult.

units.source_text: 但倘那人不能使我称心，倒叫我麻烦了。”

en.t: But if she does not please me, that would only make things troublesome."

units.source_text: 因此对这女子并不十分向往。

en.t: For that reason, he did not feel any very strong longing for this young woman.
